guarantees.title: 30-Day Walkaway Guarantee
guarantees.summary: No 12-month vendor traps. If you aren't satisfied for any reason—in month one or month twenty—give us 30 days' written notice and walk away cleanly with zero early-termination penalties.

guarantees.title: 42-Point Room-by-Room Verification
guarantees.summary: Instead of vague promises, every visit follows our structured 42-point checklist with timestamped completion photos logged by your dedicated team lead before leaving.

guarantees.title: Direct Owner & Supervisor Accountability
guarantees.summary: We never sell your account to subcontractors. Every cleaner is our own background-checked W-2 employee, and you have direct text and phone access to Debra and your route supervisor.

homeFaqs.q: Do I have to sign a long-term cleaning contract?
homeFaqs.a: No. Whether you book recurring house cleaning or nightly office janitorial service, we never lock you into a 1-year or 3-year contract. You can pause, adjust, or cancel anytime with our 30-Day Walkaway Guarantee.

homeFaqs.q: Do you bring all the cleaning supplies, vacuums, and equipment?
homeFaqs.a: Yes! We bring everything needed for your home or office—including commercial HEPA vacuums that trap pet dander and dust, fresh color-coded microfiber cloths so bathroom rags never touch kitchen counters, and safe, effective cleaning products.

homeFaqs.q: Will the same cleaning team come to my home or office every visit?
homeFaqs.a: Yes. Unlike national cleaning brokers that subcontract your job to rotating strangers, we send our own background-checked, W-2 employees from Rocklin so you always have a consistent, familiar team you can trust.

homeFaqs.q: How do you handle keys, smart locks, alarms, and pets?
homeFaqs.a: Your keys and access codes are tagged with a private security number—never labeled with your name or address—and our team lead double-checks every door lock and alarm before leaving. For residential clients, we love dogs and cats and note all pet instructions on your profile.

homeFaqs.q: How do you make sure nothing gets overlooked during a cleaning?
homeFaqs.a: Every visit follows our 42-point room-by-room checklist, and our team lead conducts a final walkthrough and logs timestamped completion photos before leaving your property.

homeFaqs.q: Can you restock paper towels, toilet paper, trash liners, and hand soap for our office?
homeFaqs.a: Absolutely. We can restock your restrooms and breakrooms from your supply closet and text you when inventory runs low, or we can deliver commercial paper goods, trash liners, and soap directly on your monthly invoice.

homeFaqs.q: How quickly can you provide proof of insurance (COI) and a W-9?
homeFaqs.a: Within 24 hours (and same-day for urgent move-ins or commercial turnovers). We are fully licensed, bonded, and carry full commercial general liability and workers' compensation insurance.
